sources.name: GDACS
sources.description: Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System – real‑time alerts for earthquakes, floods, tropical cyclones, and other natural disasters. Provided by the UN OCHA and European Commission.

sources.name: USGS Earthquakes

sources.name: NASA FIRMS
sources.description: Fire Information for Resource Management System – real‑time global fire data from MODIS and VIIRS satellites. Public domain.

sources.name: ReliefWeb
sources.description: UN OCHA's humanitarian information portal – provides situation reports, maps, and infographics on global crises. Authoritative source for humanitarian operations.

sources.name: HDX HAPI
sources.description: Humanitarian Data Exchange – Humanitarian API. Provides harmonised data on food security, conflict, displacement, and health from OCHA and partner organisations.

sources.name: ECHO Daily Flash
sources.description: European Commission's Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations – daily flash updates on natural disasters and conflicts.

sources.name: WMO Weather
sources.description: World Meteorological Organization – global weather, climate, and water data. Used for extreme weather early warnings.

sources.name: NOAA NCEI
sources.description: National Centers for Environmental Information – climate and weather data, including historical storm tracks and climate anomalies.

sources.name: EM-DAT
sources.description: International Disaster Database (CRED) – historical disaster data for trend analysis and backtesting.

sources.name: ACLED

sources.name: UCDP

sources.name: GEOGLAM

sources.name: OCHA FTS

sources.name: WarTranslated

sources.name: IRIN News

sources.name: The Carter Center

sources.name: FAO GIEWS
